title: dtls-x509 BENCH over TSCH on EMULATED nRF52840-DK (latency numbers, Contiki server)

test.description: Server (node 1) = Contiki x509-native-dtls-server (RPL root + TSCH coordinator). Client (node 2) = dtls-x509-bench built -DBENCH_SERVER_IS_ROOT, 10 iters, short settle. UDGM lossless. Passes when the client prints its FINAL summary; the FINAL line carries the TSCH handshake-latency distribution (median/p95) to log alongside the CSMA hardware numbers.
